workflow_name: Expenses document date for later period v/s posting date in previous period / qtr
workflow_description: Flag line items where Document Date falls in a later accounting month-year than Posting Date, including across years, indicating potential timing irregularities.
business_logic_plan: Business Logic Plan: Expenses document date for later period v/s posting date in previous period / qtr Data Source List each required file and its columns: Required File 1: data/uploads/e5437e1e-1c84-4865-8b8c-b032ea82cbc1/FBL3N.csv Required Columns: ["Company Code", "Business Area", "Document Number", "Posting Key", "G/L Account", "G/L Acct Long Text", "G/L Acct Long Text.1", "Cost Center", "Profit Center", "Document Date", "Posting Date", "Year/month", "Document Type", "Amount in local currency", "Local Currency", "Amount in doc. curr.", "Document currency", "Text", "Document Header Text", "Reference", "Reference Key 1", "Reference Key 2", "Reference Key 3", "Offsett.account type", "Offsetting acct no.", "User Name", "Entry Date"] Requirements List every question asked (without the multiple choice options) and the user's answer: Q1: Which rule should determine an exception based on Document Date vs Posting Date? A1: Flag whenever Document Date month-year > Posting Date month-year (any positive month difference, including cross-year) Q2: How should we restrict the scope to ‘expense’ line items in FBL3N.csv? A2: Do not restrict by expense scope; include all G/L Accounts Q3: Should we exclude any specific Document Types from FBL3N.csv when flagging exceptions? A3: Do not exclude by Document Type; include all Document Types Q4: Do you want to apply a materiality threshold on Amount in local currency when flagging exceptions? A4: No threshold; include all amounts (use Amount in local currency as-is) Q5: Should we exclude obvious reversal or month-end adjustment entries based on descriptive fields? A5: Exclude entries where Document Header Text or Text contains 'reversal' (use Document Header Text and Text) Q6: Should we include both debit and credit line items, or restrict to one side? A6: Include both debits and credits (no restriction on Amount in local currency or Posting Key) Q7: Which analysis period should we include when evaluating exceptions? A7: Include all available periods (no date range filter) Q8: At what granularity should exceptions be reported? A8: Line-item level: one row per FBL3N line (use Document Number, Posting Key, G/L Account, Cost Center, etc.) Q9: Does this output structure look good to you? A9: This output structure looks perfect - proceed with this Q10: Before I generate the complete business logic plan, is there anything else I should know? A10: No, I think we've covered everything - please generate the plan Business Logic Detailed step-by-step logic that a data analyst can follow to implement this workflow in code: Step 1: Load data from data/uploads/e5437e1e-1c84-4865-8b8c-b032ea82cbc1/FBL3N.csv into a dataframe named df. Ensure headers are read as-is. Step 2: Parse date columns: - Convert "Document Date", "Posting Date", and "Entry Date" to datetime. Use day-first inference if needed and coerce errors to NaT. - Drop rows where either "Document Date" or "Posting Date" is null after parsing, as these cannot be evaluated. Step 3: Prepare auxiliary date components: - Create integer columns: - doc_year = year("Document Date") - doc_month = month("Document Date") - post_year = year("Posting Date") - post_month = month("Posting Date") - Create month index columns for comparison: - doc_month_index = doc_year * 12 + doc_month - post_month_index = post_year * 12 + post_month Step 4: Compute calculated fields required by output: - "Month_Diff_Doc_vs_Post" = doc_month_index - post_month_index (integer; positive means Document Date is later than Posting Date in month-year terms) - "Doc_Quarter" = string formatted as f"{doc_year}-Q{((doc_month - 1) // 3) + 1}" - "Post_Quarter" = string formatted as f"{post_year}-Q{((post_month - 1) // 3) + 1}" - "Cross_Year_Flag" = "Yes" if doc_year > post_year else "No" - "Exception_Flag" = "Yes" for rows that meet the exception rule (to be assigned after filtering in Step 7) Step 5: Normalize text fields for filtering (without altering original columns): - For "Document Header Text" and "Text", create helper lowercase copies (e.g., doc_header_text_lc, text_lc) using .str.lower(); treat nulls as empty strings. Step 6: Exclude obvious reversal entries based on descriptive fields: - Build a boolean reversal_mask = (doc_header_text_lc contains "reversal") OR (text_lc contains "reversal") - Filter df to keep only rows where reversal_mask is False. - Note: substring search should be case-insensitive; ensure null-safe handling. Step 7: Apply exception rule: - Keep rows where "Month_Diff_Doc_vs_Post" > 0. - No additional filters on amount, document type, G/L scope, or posting side are applied (per requirements). Step 8: Set "Exception_Flag": - For the remaining rows (after Step 7), set "Exception_Flag" = "Yes". - If producing an intermediate dataset before filtering, ensure only the filtered rows are output so Exception_Flag is consistently "Yes". Step 9: Data typing and numeric coercions (optional but recommended): - Coerce "Amount in local currency" and "Amount in doc. curr." to numeric (handle thousand separators and decimal marks as present; coerce errors to NaN). - Keep currency columns "Local Currency" and "Document currency" as string. Step 10: Select and order columns for the final output exactly as specified in Output Dataframe Structure. Ensure that all required identification, context, and calculated columns are present. Step 11: Sorting (recommended for reviewability): - Sort by "Company Code", "Posting Date" ascending, "Document Number", then "Posting Key". Step 12: Export: - Write the resulting dataframe to the desired output (e.g., CSV) with UTF-8 encoding, preserving the column order defined in the Output Dataframe Structure. Output Dataframe Structure List each output column with its description: Company Code: Legal entity identifier from FBL3N.csv. Business Area: Organizational attribution for the line item from FBL3N.csv. Document Number: Unique document identifier from FBL3N.csv. Posting Key: Line item posting key within the document from FBL3N.csv. G/L Account: General ledger account number from FBL3N.csv. G/L Acct Long Text: Primary G/L account description from FBL3N.csv. G/L Acct Long Text.1: Secondary G/L account description (alternate/duplicate text) from FBL3N.csv. Cost Center: Cost center associated with the line item from FBL3N.csv. Profit Center: Profit center associated with the line item from FBL3N.csv. Document Date: The document date from FBL3N.csv (parsed as date); used in exception comparison. Posting Date: The posting date from FBL3N.csv (parsed as date); used in exception comparison. Year/month: Existing posting period context from FBL3N.csv (kept as-is). Document Type: SAP document type from FBL3N.csv (included for context; not filtered). Amount in local currency: Line item amount in local currency from FBL3N.csv. Local Currency: Local currency code corresponding to the amount from FBL3N.csv. Amount in doc. curr.: Line item amount in document currency from FBL3N.csv. Document currency: Document currency code from FBL3N.csv. Text: Line item text from FBL3N.csv; also used to exclude entries containing 'reversal'. Document Header Text: Document header text from FBL3N.csv; also used to exclude entries containing 'reversal'. Reference: Reference field from FBL3N.csv for traceability. Reference Key 1: Additional reference from FBL3N.csv for source tracing. Reference Key 2: Additional reference from FBL3N.csv for source tracing. Reference Key 3: Additional reference from FBL3N.csv for source tracing. Offsett.account type: Offsetting account type from FBL3N.csv. Offsetting acct no.: Offsetting account number from FBL3N.csv. User Name: User who posted the entry from FBL3N.csv. Entry Date: Date the entry was captured from FBL3N.csv (parsed as date). Month_Diff_Doc_vs_Post: Calculated integer equal to (doc_year*12 + doc_month) - (post_year*12 + post_month); positive values indicate Document Date month-year is later than Posting Date month-year. Doc_Quarter: Calculated quarter for Document Date in the format "YYYY-Q#" based on Document Date month. Post_Quarter: Calculated quarter for Posting Date in the format "YYYY-Q#" based on Posting Date month. Cross_Year_Flag: "Yes" if Document Date year > Posting Date year, otherwise "No". Exception_Flag: Constant "Yes" for all rows in the output, indicating the line item met the exception rule.
